Airflow: Face velocity approximately 0.6 m/s; top exhaust. Airflow Monitor: Front-mounted digital display with low-airflow alarm. Service Valves: Gas, water and air connections on the front panel. Temperature Control: Digital PID controller. Electricals: LED lighting, flash switches and 220 V socket(s). Safety: Low-airflow alarm, spark-free electricals and chemical-resistant surfaces. Exhaust Pump: Suitable exhaust pump shall be included (without scrubber.) SITC: The quoted price shall be inclusive of Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning ( SITC). 4.
